skills.description: Write a positioning statement: audience, problem, alternative, and why this product wins.
skills.use_when: The offer, audience, or differentiation is unclear or being redefined.

skills.description: Define a brand voice guide with tone rules, example lines, and phrases to avoid.
skills.use_when: Copy sounds inconsistent or a voice guide is needed.

skills.description: Plan a product or feature launch across channels with dates, owners, and success metrics.
skills.use_when: A launch, release, or campaign needs a dated plan.

skills.description: Compare competitors' offers, pricing, messaging, and channels from public pages.
skills.use_when: Someone asks how competitors position, price, or market.

skills.description: Design interview questions and synthesize customer quotes into themes and objections.
skills.use_when: Customer research, interviews, or voice-of-customer analysis is needed.

skills.description: Find and cluster search keywords by intent, volume, and difficulty.
skills.use_when: Choosing topics or keywords to target in search.

skills.description: Audit crawlability, indexing, redirects, canonicals, structured data, and page speed.
skills.use_when: A site has search visibility or indexing problems.

skills.description: Check whether AI assistants and AI Overviews cite a brand, and how to earn citations.
skills.use_when: The question is about ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews, or generative engine optimization.

skills.description: Write a sourced, search-optimized blog article from a topic or brief.
skills.use_when: A full article or blog draft is requested.

skills.description: Plan a publishing calendar across topics, formats, and dates.
skills.use_when: Planning what content to publish and when.

skills.description: Turn a customer result into a structured case study with evidence.
skills.use_when: A customer story or proof piece is needed.

skills.description: Build and optimize search ad campaigns: keywords, match types, ad copy, bidding.
skills.use_when: Google Ads or Microsoft Ads search campaigns.

skills.description: Plan and write paid social campaigns for Meta, LinkedIn, or TikTok with audiences and creative angles.
skills.use_when: Paid campaigns on social platforms.

skills.description: Audit an ad account for wasted spend, tracking gaps, and structure problems.
skills.use_when: Ad performance is poor or an account needs a review.

skills.description: Write platform-native social posts and threads from a source idea.
skills.use_when: Organic posts for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, or similar.

skills.description: Plan community engagement, rituals, and moderation for a group or forum.
skills.use_when: Running or growing an online community.

skills.description: Write an email sequence (welcome, nurture, launch, win-back) with timing and goals.
skills.use_when: Email campaigns, newsletters, or lifecycle automation.

skills.description: Script a short or long video with hook, beats, and call to action.
skills.use_when: A YouTube video, reel, or short needs a script.

skills.description: Write a creative brief or image prompt for ads, thumbnails, or social visuals.
skills.use_when: Visual assets, thumbnails, or image generation are needed.

skills.description: Build a performance report from analytics or ad data with trends and next actions.
skills.use_when: Reporting on traffic, conversions, or campaign results.

skills.description: Design an experiment with hypothesis, metric, sample size, and guardrails.
skills.use_when: Planning an A/B test or measuring a change.

skills.description: Write and structure a conversion-focused landing page.
skills.use_when: A landing page, sales page, or signup page is being created or rewritten.

skills.description: Audit a page or funnel for friction, trust gaps, and conversion blockers.
skills.use_when: A page or funnel converts poorly.

skills.description: Run several skills in order with review gates, from brief to published asset.
skills.use_when: The outcome needs research, writing, review, and publishing in sequence.
